scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -k -n WEB,SERVER,WORKER "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w agent"
scripts.e2e:dashboard: npm run db:up && npm run e2e:dashboard -w server
scripts.test: npm run db:up && npm run test:prepare -w server && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
